parsed.name: ensemble_consensus_global
parsed.strategy: Only names at least two independent lenses would pick: catalysts (a dated event inside Oct 12-Nov 13 or a primary PDUFA), revision flow (net_raises positive with a real n_firms count), power/grid (AI bottleneck capex), quality momentum (inflection_flag, gross_margin_chg positive, near 52w high), or policy (defense budgets, MFN shielding). The book is semis plus biotech catalysts plus power/grid plus European defense, all with dated prints or PDUFAs in the window. I would be wrong if a single macro shock (hyperscaler capex pause, China export-control headline, or a de-escalation that compresses defense premia) hits the correlated semis and defense sleeves at once, or if the binary PDUFAs (MRK Oct 10, VRTX Nov 30) draw CRLs.
parsed.objective: Maximize relative P&L versus the Bloomberg WLS index from 2026-10-12 to 2026-11-13 using only names two or more independent lenses would select.
